# Directives that predate the "since" requirement.
#
# STABILITY.md commits slinit-service(5) to marking each NEW directive
# with the version it appeared in. Everything listed here already
# existed when that requirement took effect, so it is exempt: 286 of
# them shipped by v1.10.55 and no-boot-marker at v2.2.9.
#
# Do not add to this file. A directive added from now on needs a
# "(since X.Y.Z)" marker in doc/man/slinit-service.5.md instead --
# that is what TestNewDirectivesCarrySinceMarker checks, and adding
# the name here to silence it defeats the only reason the file exists.
